moments.title: More confident after eight sessions, but still a long way to go
moments.summary: A participant, greeted in the clip as Malika, says she is much more confident than when she started but still has a way to go, which is why the course is being extended.
moments.evidence: we've just finished the first eight sessions and while I'm much more confident from where I started I still think I have a little bit of a long way to go

moments.title: What surprised her was how little she actually knew
moments.summary: Asked what surprised her most, she answers that it was how little she knew — and that the more you learn, the more you realise how little you know.
moments.evidence: How little I actually knew. I knew I knew very little but I think the more you learn the more you realize how little you know.

moments.title: The concept that stuck: gold, the dollar and the economy
moments.summary: Asked for one concept she learned, she names the relationship between gold, the dollar and the economy as the thing she found most interesting.
moments.evidence: I really, I think, noticed the relationship between gold and the dollar and the economy and that was very interesting to me.

moments.title: Nightly conversations with her husband about their mutual funds and life insurance
moments.summary: Asked what she has discussed with her husband, she says it has become a running joke that she tells him what she learned that night, and that they now discuss the different mutual funds they are invested in and life insurance.
moments.evidence: so many things that I've learned and I discuss with him all about the different mutual funds that we've invested in, life insurance, etc.

moments.title: Not yet in control of her money, but definitely more confident
moments.summary: Asked whether she feels more in control of her money, she declines to overclaim: she has not started controlling it yet, but she does feel more confident.
moments.evidence: I've not yet started controlling my money but I definitely feel more confident.

moments.title: She can now follow finance articles in the newspaper
moments.summary: Asked what she will do differently, she says she can understand newspaper articles about finance better, and calls that a daily change in her life.
moments.evidence: when I read newspaper articles on things related to finance I can understand better and I think that's been a daily sort of change in my life.

moments.title: Completely comfortable asking questions in the sessions
moments.summary: Asked whether she felt comfortable asking questions, she says absolutely, and describes the teacher as the nicest, sweetest and most informative. The transcript renders the pronoun as "He".
moments.evidence: He really is just the nicest, sweetest and most informative teacher and very helpful.

moments.title: The most fun part was doing the course with her friends
moments.summary: Asked for the most fun part, she says doing it with her friends, and recommends taking the course with friends so you can laugh in the middle of it.
moments.evidence: Doing it with my friends. I would highly recommend doing this course with your friends because you can also laugh in the middle of it which is great.

moments.title: Nothing was too embarrassing to ask
moments.summary: Asked what question she had always been too embarrassed to ask, she says they asked every smallest detail question and were never embarrassed.
moments.evidence: I think we've asked every smallest detail question so I don't think we were embarrassed
